title: Authorized public record discovery and readiness replay
scope: Current isolated local macOS arm64 metadata record discovery over signed native QUIC and bearer HTTP, journal readiness, restart, SDK fetch/source projection and affected regressions. HTTP record-body IO and full auxiliary conformance remain unqualified.
behavior: RecordAvailability in authorized snapshot/event contracts distinguishes pending, ready and unavailable. Only ready includes UUID/revision. No canonical/manifest digest, storage URI, body, private source/count or captured-audio assertion enters discovery.

Discovery requires explicit record_get, current Session source/subject authorization and frozen original record epoch or explicit current Session history share. It is independent of session_get. Cached pages recheck state and authorization, suppressing stale ready revisions; a fresh snapshot reports deleted/missing materialized records unavailable without handle.

Producer atomically commits record bytes/source epochs/ready state/snapshot release and bounded original readiness journal entries. Journal budget refusal rolls back all of them and retries the unchanged intent. Durable journal replay and fresh snapshots survive Store reopen. Journal row keeps actual Session revision and provenance; typed Ready carries record revision.

Current journal projection refuses removed/rejoined members, changed/absent ready revisions and missing record permission before page counts. Canonical finite/live subscriptions emit schema-valid recording.vcon-ready with source cid/sid, UUID/revision, encrypted false and empty signer list for this unsigned metadata policy, followed by its cursor fact. Sixty-three two-frame readiness facts plus ACK fit the127-frame subscription budget.

Native and HTTP Rust SDK conversation_records returns one bounded snapshot page with next token and cursor. It exposes no private topology to record-only readers and rejects malformed/extraneous ready metadata. Signed readiness replies validate their actual Session scope instead of requiring a Conversation subscription to carry sid.

Expanded actual runtime case covers EdDSA and ES256, complete public discovery/fetch without privileged selector lookup, exactly one typed readiness hint on catch-up, full server restart and fresh native rediscovery, independently invited callee record-only bearer HTTP discovery with one-item pagination, and existing exact digest/attenuation/conditional/local-miss body behavior.
